text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alerts: multiple GPU OOMs during prefill on gpu-pool-7 (node: gpu-7c). 3 containers restarted in the last 5m. Prefill spike from long-context chat bursts. https://internal.redwood/ops/alerts/1769999991

anna_oncall: acked, I'm on it. Paging SRE.

miguel_sre: oncall pinged. quick check: are these all same node or spread?

ops-bot: All alerts show node=gpu-7c, container runtime=redwood-runtime-v1.4. Prefill sequences > 200k tokens in these traces.

lina_runtime: jumping in — attaching the latest container logs.

lina_runtime: ```
[2026-06-12T14:03:12Z] runtime: prefill_start seq_id=abc123 tokens=217894 memory=23.9GB
[2026-06-12T14:03:14Z] runtime: cudaAlloc error: out of memory (attempted 364MB)
[2026-06-12T14:03:14Z] container: restarting due to SIGKILL
```

miguel_sre: looks like long prefill sequences are exhausting vram; KV cache growth + fragmentation. Are we seeing kvcache retention > expected?

lina_runtime: yes — kvcache retained across multiplexed chats. Prefill path doesn't trim intermediate sessions. Also some requests have chatburst flag set causing aggressive prefix expansion.

carol_support: customer-impact note: we've received 2 support tickets complaining about dropped completions for large transcripts on Hosted API. Affected customers: chat-coach-prod, transcriptify. I flagged them.

anna_oncall: mitigation plan proposals: (1) temporary throttling rule to reject prefill requests with tokens > 100k for gpu-pool-7, (2) enable kv-cache soft-trim on that pool, (3) rotate traffic away from gpu-7c. Which can we do fast?

miguel_sre: I can apply eviction/soft-trim via runtime-feature flags to gpu-pool-7 now (takes ~90s to propagate). I can also add a routing rule to steer new prefill-heavy requests to cpu-fallback or other pools. Draining node gpu-7c might require a short eviction window.

jen_prodeng: recommend also pushing a quick rate-limit for the chatburst header at the gateway so we don't impact other customers. We should avoid a broad global throttle.

lina_runtime: preparing a hotpatch: small change to prefill path that caps per-request kv growth and forces prefix-compact. Will push to prod canary to pool-8 first. Build in progress (CI 4782).

tracebot: trace created: 1769999991-TRC, includes sample trace of failing prefill sequence (attached).

miguel_sre: immediate actions executed: 1) applied soft-kv-trim flag to gpu-pool-7, 2) added route to steer new prefill requests >100k tokens to cpu-fallback, 3) marked gpu-7c for drain. Monitoring.

anna_oncall: customer comms: Carol, can you send a short status note to affected customers stating we're mitigating and will follow up with root cause? Keep it limited to impact and ETA.

carol_support: on it. Draft: "We're investigating elevated container restarts for large-context prefills. We're routing traffic and applying mitigations; some long transcripts may see rejections or slower responses. We'll provide an update in 30m."

lina_runtime: canary build passed on pool-8. Rolling hotpatch to gpu-pool-7 standby nodes (3 nodes) now. Rolling plan: one node at a time, health-check gating.

miguel_sre: drain of gpu-7c started: evicting pods, reallocating workloads. If eviction rate hits issues, we'll re-evaluate and call for node reboot.

anna_oncall: tracking notes: - Incident type: GPU OOM during prefill (long chatbursts) - Impact: container restarts, some customer requests failed - Pager: SRE + Runtime + Support engaged - Mitigation: routing, soft-kv-trim, hotpatch rollout, node drain - ETA for next update: 30m

carol_support: sent customer note to chat-coach-prod + transcriptify (copied on internal). Will update after hotpatch rollout.

lina_runtime: hotpatch rolled to 2/3 nodes; observing 60% reduction in KV growth on canary traces. No new OOMs reported on patched nodes.

miguel_sre: routing rule looks effective — prefill-heavy traffic to gpu-pool-9 and cpu-fallback. gpu-7c still draining but no new restarts on other nodes.

anna_oncall: nice work. Next steps: finish patch rollout, keep node drained until OS/kernel page reclaim confirmed, follow up with postmortem. Assigning owner for RCA: lina_runtime + miguel_sre.

carol_support: customers acknowledged mitigation and asked for timeline on permanent fix. I'll coordinate postmortem summary for them.

lina_runtime: quick note for RCA: investigate prefix compaction gap and chatburst header semantics; consider adding per-tenant kv hard caps and prefill quota.

miguel_sre: logging action: add OOM trace markers to incident export and link to ticket INC-1769999991.

anna_oncall: closing loop for now — monitoring for 1h. If anything spikes, re-open. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident update: mitigations applied. Status=stabilized. Metrics: OOM restarts down to 0 over last 10m.

anna_oncall: last check-in: stable for 45m, planning a 1:1 postmortem tomorrow. Thanks team.
